draft.subject: Next step after your Wrenfield kickoff
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Thanks again for making time for the kickoff last week — good to see your first project up in Wrenfield already. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so adding a teammate is usually the natural next step: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whatever's next for your team.

Best,
Nadia
